title: Cloud page writes: allow the cloud page tool, or keep page writes local
why: A cloud session's page writes can stall on an approval nobody sees, because the settings allow list names only the desktop connector's page tool.
source: Coordinator 20:07 and 20:08 CST Nov 11, page item 520
note: The settings allow list names only mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write (coordinator's read, 20:06 CST); cloud sessions use ArtifactData. A Degen cloud session saw page writes refused with reason mcpServerPolicy. Page item 520 asks the owner: a (recommended) keep page writes in a local session; b add ArtifactData to the allow list as a test (widens a shared tool). Under b, after the respawn a lane adds the one line and one cloud page write proves it. Waits for the fan-out (owner 13:51). Same name split as step page-tool-every-name. Owner 20:08 CST in the coordinator's chat: "add artifactdata to the allowlist please" (item 520 b), and every name the page tool goes by is allowed. A builder adds them on branch artifactdata-allow (#2608). Home triage's exact tool name is unmeasured; the allow list's mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write is the only full name in hand. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was branch artifactdata-allow, PR #2608). Lane prose-unmapped started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). Done check green on main: 5a90814eb (PR #2608 into batch 87) and 6892e6419 (batch 87, #2610); closed by coordinator 08:39 CST Nov 12.
